summary: First-finish smoke test of YourMovie's. Backend auth, media CRUD, favorites, and file/list flows mostly work. Frontend homepage, browse, login, admin panel, profile, and media detail pages render correctly and JWT-based auth works end-to-end. Two backend bugs detected: POST /api/reviews returns 500 (ObjectId serialization) and PUT /api/media/{id} returns 422 with partial payload.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials returns JWT (key: 'token'), user includes is_admin=true
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin user; without token returns 401
POST /api/auth/register creates a new (non-admin) user and returns token
GET /api/media returns 6 seeded items; ?type=movie filters correctly; ?q=Dune search works
POST /api/media as admin creates item; without token returns 401
POST /api/favorites/{id}?list_type=favorite toggles ({active:true}); GET /api/favorites returns user list; GET /api/favorites/status/{id} returns {favorite,watchlist}
Frontend homepage loads with brand 'YourMovie’s', hero (Dune), and 3 catalog carousels (Films/Séries/Animes)
Browse page /browse shows filter buttons Tout/Films/Séries/Animes
Login form accepts admin credentials and stores JWT in localStorage as ym_token (len=145); redirects to /
Admin page /admin renders stats (Total 7, Films 3, Séries 2, Animes 2), 'Ajouter un contenu' button, and media table with edit/delete actions
Profile page /profile shows Favoris (1) and Watchlist (0) tabs after favoriting
Media detail page /media/{id} shows type/year/title/description, Favori & Watchlist buttons, and reviews section

failed.evidence: Payload {media_id, rating:8, comment:'Test review'} with valid JWT returns 500. Backend log: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')] in fastapi/encoders.py → the endpoint returns a Mongo document containing raw ObjectId that FastAPI cannot serialize. Fix: strip _id or return Pydantic model.

failed.issue: PUT /api/media/{id} returns 422 with partial update payload
failed.evidence: PUT /api/media/m_202df8a41cd0 with body {"title":"TmpUpdated"} and admin JWT returns 422. Endpoint likely requires a full Media model instead of a partial/optional update schema.

failed.issue: Google OAuth button is a <button> without visible href; cannot directly assert it starts with https://auth.emergentagent.com/ from DOM
failed.evidence: querySelector for 'Google' button returned tag=BUTTON with empty href. Redirect likely happens via onClick JS. Not verified against Emergent auth URL (per instructions we did not complete OAuth).

action_items: Fix POST /api/reviews: serialize the created review without raw ObjectId (return response_model or drop _id) so review creation works from UI
After fix, verify that media rating is recomputed as average of reviews
Change PUT /api/media/{id} to accept a partial update schema (all fields Optional) so admin edit dialog can send only changed fields
Optionally: expose the Emergent OAuth target URL on the Google button (data-href or window.location assignment) so it can be asserted; ensure it starts with https://auth.emergentagent.com/
